items.title: Dubrovnik
items.summary: A historic coastal city with medieval walls.

body.value: Dubrovnik is famous for its Old Town and city walls.
Best time to visit is spring and early autumn.

items.title: Split
items.summary: A vibrant city built around Diocletian’s Palace.

body.value: Split mixes ancient history with modern life by the sea.
Don’t miss Diocletian’s Palace and the waterfront promenade.
